title: Coming Patient Pay Held Back from Resident Funds Withdrawals
content:
The spare amount a resident may withdraw from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account is reduced by **the coming patient pay kept**. It follows the account's standing authorization and the income paid into the account; the patient pay is the case's patient pay on the resident's eligible case under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage.

| Account records | Coming patient pay kept |
|---|---|
| the account's standing authorization names Medicaid patient pay, and no pension or benefit deposit has been posted in the last two months counted back from today | the case's patient pay |
| the standing authorization names Medicaid patient pay, and such a deposit has been posted | the case's patient pay less the most recent pension or benefit deposit, whichever of the two kinds was posted later (of two posted the same day, the pension), never below zero |
| otherwise | nothing |

A pension or benefit deposit is a pension paid by direct deposit or a Social Security benefit received as representative payee. "In the last two months" means fewer than two whole months have passed from the deposit's posting date to today, a whole month running to the same day number of a later month.

## Hypothetical illustration

Today is 18 September; the case's patient pay is $1046.18; the standing authorization names Medicaid patient pay.

| Deposits | Coming patient pay kept |
|---|---|
| last pension deposit 18 July; nothing since | $1046.18 (exactly two whole months have passed) |
| pension of $612.40 posted 19 July | $433.78 |
| pension of $612.40 and benefit of $988.00, both posted 3 September | $433.78 (same day: the pension) |
| benefit of $1210.00 posted 3 September | $0.00 |
| standing authorization names private room and board | nothing |
